d.ko: Amane has always lived for herself, choosing to focus on her studies and happiness. But what will she do when given magical powers beyond human comprehension to face a horde of terrible monsters? It's time for her to become Magical Girl Celesphonia!

d.zh: 天音一直为自己活着，专注于自己的学业和日常娱乐。但是当她面对一群可怕怪物时，得到了超出人类理解的魔法之力后，她又会如何选择？是时候变身为魔法少女天穹法妮雅了！
